scripts.name: add_anchor_points_1.0
scripts.description: Add Anchor Points — insert 1-5 evenly-spaced anchor points into every segment of the selected curve(s), like Illustrator's Object > Path > Add Anchor Points. Uses an exact De Casteljau split so curves keep their shape (no flattening). Fills Affinity's gap: adding nodes one click at a time.
scripts.author: olliollio
